title: A whipped Damsel's hop counts as a throw
description: The player whips a Damsel. She hops, unhurt, but falls back fast enough to count as thrown, and lies stunned where she lands, for as long as her cry for help had left to count down rather than a throw's four seconds. Then she gets up and runs.
